title: Synergistic effects of poly-silicon aluminum sulfate and auxiliary agents in dye wastewater decolorization
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5206-5219
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06377A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jie Min, Huilan Zhou, Chao Yang, Lu Wang, Jiajun Nie, Qiang Wang, Lijun Wang, Yunlong Zhao
A novel PMoA–PSAS synergy overcomes the cationic dye barrier, boosting mixed-dye decolorization from 25.3% to 92.5%. This, alongside high efficacy across nine dye classes, demonstrates the self-synthesized coagulant's strong application potential.
